name: Spades
summary: A trick-taking card game where spades are always trump and players must bid the exact number of tricks they will win.
rules_text: Deal the full 52-card deck evenly to all players. In clockwise order starting left of dealer, each player bids at least one, predicting how many tricks they will take; no passing. The player left of dealer leads to the first trick. Players must follow suit if possible, otherwise may play a spade trump or discard another suit. Spades cannot be led until spades have been broken by a previous discard or the leader holds only spades. The trick is won by the highest spade if any, otherwise highest card of the led suit; winner leads next. After 13 tricks, scores: if bid is met, 10 points per bid plus 1 per overtrick (bag). Some play deducts 100 per 10 bags. If bid is not met, 0 points. Play multiple hands until a player reaches the target, commonly 500 or 200, highest total wins.
rating_reason: Classic trick-taking bidding game, hidden hands, strategic.
